ambiguity: The writer says 'I would not let this box go to destruction' (owning the stance) but routes the final decision to the duty manager, so responsibility is mixed; coded owns because the refusal to release or to destroy on own authority is presented as the writer's judgment. Reasons: harm drives the refusal, while policy and instruction are offered as why the writer cannot grant an extension. No explicit expression of regret or concern about the family, so discomfort is false, though the emphasis on irreplaceability is strong. Remedy: customer_contact is coded loosely, since returning the box to Alex Morgan requires an address and confirmation of handover, and the contact notes are attached to the escalation. Expedite is not coded, though the written permission is requested now.

quotes.risk_disclosure: Destruction is irreversible, and the contents can't be replaced. The box holds the only copies of a late mother's letters and family photographs.
quotes.primary_reason: this box is the only copy of irreplaceable personal material
quotes.responsibility: I would not let this box go to destruction at 14:30 today
